characterDescription: The base stage of the Chikorita line: Chicoritooni as a tiny herb dinosaur with a rigatoni-textured body, a basil leaf crest, pale pasta-yellow skin, and simple starter proportions. Keep it clearly simpler than the later Arachnid Family and Arcadopus stages.
cardDescription: Chicoritooni is now the first strange sprout of the Chikorita line, the point where the joke first learns how to breathe.

characterDescription: The middle stage of the Chikorita line. Keep the exact recognizable Arachnid Family identity from the OG reference, but treat it as the bridge evolution between Chicoritooni and Arcadopus rather than a standalone boss.
cardDescription: Arachnid Family carries the Chikorita line into its louder middle act, clearly evolved but not yet the last word.

characterDescription: The final stage of the Chikorita line. Keep the exact recognizable Arcadopus identity from the OG reference and let it read as the completed payoff of the family.
cardDescription: Arcadopus closes the Chikorita line as the fully realized payoff form.

cardDescription: Cyndaqwilli is the first spark of the Cyndaquil line, still compact, still volatile, and only beginning to glow.

cardDescription: Totodilli is the first bite of the Totodile line, a small troublemaker that still has plenty of monster left to grow.

characterDescription: The middle stage of the Totodile line. Keep the exact recognizable Avocadorilla identity from the OG reference, but treat it as the bridge evolution between Totodilli and Bambu Bambu Sahur rather than a standalone boss.

characterDescription: The final stage of the Totodile line. Keep the exact recognizable Bambu Bambu Sahur identity from the OG reference and let it read as the completed payoff of the family.

characterDescription: The base stage of the Bombardino family: an unmistakable baby Bombardiro-like creature, with a tiny rounded bomber fuselage, a short crocodile snout already fused into the nose, little tooth hints, small predatory eyes, stub wings, and a soft juvenile propeller-belly silhouette. It should read clearly as the infant common ancestor of Bombardiro Crocodilo before the goose and hippo branches split away.
cardDescription: The little bomber already looked like trouble in reptile form, just not old enough to level a city yet.

characterDescription: The crocodile branch of the Bombardino family: Bombardiro Crocodilo as a military bomber with a crocodile head fused into the fuselage, broad destructive wings, and a full airborne predator silhouette. Keep the iconic OG identity, but let it read as one completed branch of the same bomber family.
cardDescription: Bombardiro Crocodilo finished one branch by turning the whole joke into an air raid with teeth.

cardDescription: Brr es Teh Patipum starts the Ledyba line as the smallest version of the bit before the full chaos arrives.

cardDescription: Cappuccino Assassino steps into the line's middle act with twin blades drawn and enough menace to darken the whole street.

cardDescription: Cocoa Assassino is where the coffee killer family begins, still sweet-looking until the marshmallow blades come out.

characterDescription: The iconic Coffin Tung Tung Tung Sahur kept as a standalone OG brainrot rather than tied to an unrelated family. Preserve the full ritual coffin silhouette and let it read as a complete finished creature.
cardDescription: Coffin Tung Tung Tung Sahur now lands as its own finished omen, carrying the whole ritual with no pre-evolution needed.

characterDescription: The iconic Ballerino Lololo kept as a standalone mythic: a muscular frappé dancer with human arms and legs, ballet grace, a shaker in hand, and a theatrical airborne stage presence. Preserve the exact recognizable coffee-story legend rather than forcing him into an evolution line.
cardDescription: Ballerino Lololo leaps across the stage like a rumor too glamorous to die.

characterDescription: A branch-final of the Assassino coffee family: a cold blended frappuccino ninja, still a stealth killer of the night, but with a frostier drink silhouette, smoother assassin lines, and a colder more specialized payoff than Cappuccino Assassino.
cardDescription: Frappocino Assassino finishes one branch of the family as the frozen hitman who arrives after the street has already gone quiet.

characterDescription: A branch-final of the Assassino coffee family: a matcha-green assassin spirit stalking a moonlit alley with two Japanese katanas, a calmer deadlier posture, and a more disciplined samurai silhouette than Cappuccino Assassino.
cardDescription: Matchaino Assassino ends the other branch in a silence so sharp it feels cut by the blade.

characterDescription: The iconic Espressona Signora kept as a standalone rival mythic: a seductive coffee-mug-headed lady dressed in all black, smoking a cigarette, with a darker cartoony silhouette and meaner elegance than Ballerina Cappuccina. Preserve her exact recognizable coffee-story rival identity rather than forcing an evolution line.
cardDescription: Espressona Signora enters like gossip with a cigarette, and somehow the whole stage goes colder at once.

cardDescription: Gelato Pebblino is the first cold pebble of the Sudowoodo line, still small enough to fit in a palm and already too strange to ignore.

characterDescription: The final stage of the Sudowoodo line. Keep the exact recognizable Ice Dragon identity from the OG reference and let it read as the fully evolved icy payoff rather than a standalone species.

cardDescription: Pipi Kiwi Maximo closes the Aipom line by turning the first little joke into a full double-handed menace.

cardDescription: Te Te Sahur is the first buzzing knock of the Yanma line, still slim, still quick, and not yet the full morning alarm.

Keep the OG identity, but make it read as a full alternate final branch from the same tiny plane base.
cardDescription: One branch grew heavier than the others and started bombing with the confidence of a flying tank.

cardDescription: Urubini Flamenguini now stands on its own instead of closing the Footera family.

characterDescription: The dark branch and mythic end route: Gangster Footera as the completed hooded street-fox with the enormous sneaker-foot, dark blue hooded jacket, yellow trim, blocky grey cap, narrow slit eyes, and intimidating alley-boss swagger from the OG reference. Keep it clearly darker, sleeker, and more menacing than the other Footera branches.
cardDescription: Gangster Footera lands like the forbidden night route, one giant step away from a mugging and a miracle.

characterDescription: The grass branch: a leaf-rich Footera that keeps the giant sneaker-foot, sly eyes, hooded street-creature body, and cap silhouette, but grows vine laces, mossy trim, leaf frills, and a fast hedge-runner posture. It should feel like the green route of the same family rather than a different animal.
cardDescription: The grass route taught Footera to cut corners through hedges and come back greener than before.
